scripts.dev: bun run dev:shared & bun run dev:web
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:web && bun run build:events
scripts.build:web: bun --cwd packages/web/client build && bun --cwd packages/web/server build
scripts.deploy:dev: bun run build && bkper apps deploy --dev
scripts.deploy:dev:events: bun run build && bkper apps deploy --dev --events
